home.title: BNY • Director, Product Design • Carl Avidano
home.description: Carl Avidano’s selected work for BNY: complex service workflows, research, accessible design systems, and collaboration with stakeholders and developers.
home.headline: I turn complex workflows into accessible interfaces.
home.introduction: Hi, I’m Carl, and I’m excited to apply for BNY’s Director, Product Design role. I bring more than 15 years of experience designing public services and the tools behind them. The opportunity to work through complex problems with your Fund & Investor Solutions team, while helping designers develop their work, is what draws me to this role.
home.projectsIntroduction: I’ve selected the following case studies to highlight the work and outcomes most relevant to your team: connecting complex workflows, making research useful, and developing patterns that others can build on.
home.who: I'm a UX manager, researcher, and design systems engineer. I've collaborated with government agencies, international nonprofits, educational organizations, and intergovernmental organizations.
home.what: I connect UX research with inclusive design and working code. I’ve managed and mentored designers, aligned stakeholders around a shared strategy, and built inclusive design systems.
